name: AVC_benchmark
description: AVC_benchmark evaluates models' ability to determine audio–visual correspondence — i.e., whether an audio clip and a video clip match — and to learn aligned multimodal representations. It typically contains paired audio and video segments labeled as matched or mismatched and is used for tasks such as binary matching and contrastive learning. The benchmark assesses robustness of audio-visual feature learning under varied conditions (noise, mismatches).
reputation: Moderately used in multimodal/self-supervised learning research as a standard audio–visual correspondence benchmark.
